text: When asserting on terminal output, prefer `rich.console.Console.record_render` and `rich.test.get_rich_repr` over direct string matching of ANSI escape codes.
Avoid asserting on the exact sequence of ANSI escape codes; their order or presence can vary slightly between Rich versions or configurations while still producing the correct visual output.
Tests in this repository often require specific Python versions or environments to reproduce bugs. Ensure the test environment matches the bug report's context.

When a test passes unexpectedly, it's crucial to verify that the test setup accurately reflects the conditions under which the bug was observed, including Python version and any relevant environment variables.
